utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the twenty-ninth of June. Can you all hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, got you. Only just made it in, mind. Traffic on the ring road was absolutely crawling.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Same. Ten minutes looking at the back of the same skip wagon.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: While we're on vehicles, whose new car is that in the car park? Very shiny for this place.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Mine. Give it a week, it'll be the same colour as everyone else's.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Factory grey. Comes free with the parking space.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. And the heating in the portakabin's still making it feel like November indoors, except backwards. Anyway, that's me moaning, not a job request.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I've got the window open and I'm still cooking.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, quick round. Finished stuff first, then what actually needs agreeing.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah so, tested the boiler safety valve yesterday and it's all fine now.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: That's finished, then? Nothing outstanding from the test?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Finished, yeah. All fine. Just closing the loop.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And I signed off the inspection on the Compressed Air Dryer on Tuesday. That's already done as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Last Tuesday, yeah? Not something booked for tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Last Tuesday, correct. Old news, just hadn't said it on here.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I've already swapped the filter on the pick and place on two yesterday, as well.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, nights knew that had been done.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good. Nothing else on that from me.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Couple of observations, then. Noticed the number two bearing was running a bit warm on nights, but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Settled back to normal, or just stopped climbing?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Back to normal. Just passing on what we saw, not putting another job up.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Also saw the pressure on the HV switchboard dip for a few minutes. It came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped out. Came back without anyone doing anything?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, on its own. Again, observation only.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: My blocker hasn't changed. Still waiting on parts for the Line 1 Mould Temperature Controller. Nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, they're not here. No arrival to report, unfortunately.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, that stays blocked. Not dressing it up as something we can get done today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll do a site visit at Harbour Road Warehouse with the contractor this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Right, I've got Sarah Okafor against that one, this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Um, I'll write up the near miss at the stretch wrapper first thing tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Tomasz. That's holding production up so it needs doing first. First thing tomorrow, as you said.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Understood. I'll do that first thing tomorrow, ahead of anything else.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, the write-up's the bit we're held on. That needs to stay at the top.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie, can you grease and check the bearings on the line 3 screw by Wednesday? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take that. Grease and check the bearings on the line 3 screw by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Just—sorry, talking over you. That needs the downtime lined up with production, doesn't it?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: It does. We need someone to schedule downtime for the line 3 screw with production tomorrow. Who can take the scheduling bit?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I can't take ownership of that one. Don't put it against me just because you said production.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And I'm accepting the bearing work, not the downtime scheduling. Just so we're not assuming I've picked up both.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fair enough. Scheduling downtime for the line 3 screw with production tomorrow is needed, but it's unowned. Nobody's taken it.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: The bearing work is still mine, by Wednesday. I'm not dropping that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Agreed. Not an emergency, but that Wednesday deadline doesn't slip.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: There's also organising the toolbox talk for the team after lunch. That still needs someone.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, after lunch, whenever you get a chance. It's not a drop-everything one. Any takers for organising it?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I'm flagging it rather than volunteering, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I can't take that either, I'm afraid.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Toolbox talk organisation stays unassigned, then. Nobody against it.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: One more needing an owner: run a function test on the line 2 guard by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: That's fairly important. By the end of the week, definitely, rather than letting it drift.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah. I'm raising it, not saying I'll do it. Haven't taken ownership.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I can't commit to that one either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Function test on the line 2 guard: fairly important, by the end of the week, still nobody owning it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: So the agreed owners are me for Harbour Road Warehouse with the contractor this afternoon, Tomasz for the stretch wrapper near-miss write-up first thing tomorrow, and Jamie for the line 3 screw bearings by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep. Grease and check, both. Got it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And mine is first thing tomorrow, first priority because it's holding production up. Clear.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I've kept the boiler safety valve, Compressed Air Dryer inspection and that filter swap in the completed bit. Not mixed into the new work.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Correct. And the Line 1 Mould Temperature Controller is still the parts blocker, not a fresh action.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: My two things were just observations too. Neither's me volunteering for another job.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep. The gaps are still downtime scheduling with production tomorrow, toolbox talk organisation after lunch whenever someone gets a chance, and the fairly important line 2 guard function test by the end of the week. All three unowned, not silently handed to anyone.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, that's clear. Better than everyone thinking someone else said yes.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Right, thanks everyone. I'll let you escape Teams.
